svg.title: Join Algorithms
svg.desc: Join Algorithms. Nested loop, hash join and merge join: how each joins two tables, what it costs, and when the planner picks it. Step 1, A nested loop, no index: No index on order_events.order_id: the nested loop rescans all 1,500,000 events for every order. Step 2, Nested loop + index: Joined to order_items, each of the 45 orders is one index lookup: root, branch, leaf, heap page. Step 3, Hash join, merge join: Hash: build on September's orders, probe with every item. Merge: walk two sorted inputs together. Step 4, How the planner picks: The planner costs every method from its row estimates and keeps the cheapest one for each join.

g.text: No index on order_events.order_id: the nested loop rescans all 1,500,000 events for every order.
Joined to order_items, each of the 45 orders is one index lookup: root, branch, leaf, heap page.
Hash: build on September's orders, probe with every item. Merge: walk two sorted inputs together.
The planner costs every method from its row estimates and keeps the cheapest one for each join.
